name: Cauliflower & Red Lentil Soup with Avocado and Cilantro Yogurt

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 medium carrots
1 ½ medium heads cauliflower
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger root
3 tomatoes
1 ½ small bunches cilantro
3 avocados

instructions.primary_message: Peel and medium dice the carrots and onions; place both in a large bowl.
Trim off and discard the leaves and thick stem of the cauliflower heads, then roughly chop it into bite-sized pieces; add to the bowl with the carrot and onion.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add veggies and cook, stirring occasionally, until soft, about 8 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince or grate the ginger; peel and mince the garlic.
Once the veggies are soft, add the ginger, garlic, and tomatoes to the pot. Cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Stir in broth, water, lentils, and spices. Cover and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook until lentils are tender, about 15 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1420 ml chicken or vegetable broth
6 cup water
1 ½ cup red lentils
1 tbsp cumin
¾ tsp cayenne pepper
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Place cilantro, yogurt, and salt in a medium bowl; whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups plain Greek yogurt
⅜ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Halve and pit the avocados; slice crosswise while still in the skin and scoop out with a spoon.
Using an immersion (hand) blender, process the soup until smooth. Alternatively, transfer soup to a regular blender and blend on high until smooth.
To serve, divide the soup between bowls and top with yogurt and avocado. Enjoy!
